ops.title: Dedup-key races must project the durable payload
ops.body: Concurrent writers sharing a dedup key must project the durable payload read back from the log (AppendEvent returns the existing seq on dedup), not their own request's payload — otherwise the event log and the projection diverge under a race. Fixed for answers in cc-runtime commit b99d15a (applyAnswer → durableAnswer(seq)); regression test TestRacingAnswersConvergeOnDurableAnswer.
